blog.heading: Engineering Notes & Learnings
blog.description: Deep dives into electronics design, product prototyping, and software engineering.

articles.title: Signal Integrity at 100MHz: Ground Loops Explained
articles.excerpt: Practical laboratory measurements explaining return path inductance and split ground planes in high-speed hardware.
articles.content: Deep dive into grounding and impedance matching...

articles.title: Designing Robust Hardware: Lessons from 100+ PCB Iterations
articles.excerpt: Why signal integrity, thermal dissipation, and ground-loop management are often overlooked in early prototypes and how to prevent field failures.
articles.content: Designing custom electronics is an iterative discipline where simulation can only take you so far. Ground-loop currents, capacitive crosstalk, and thermal dissipation around switching regulators require meticulous layout design. In this article, we examine common high-frequency pitfalls and design rules to adhere to.

articles.title: Bridging Silicon & Code: Building Embedded Systems That Don't Crash
articles.excerpt: Techniques for deterministic firmware design, state-machine resilience, and hardware-in-the-loop testing workflows for mission-critical electronics.
articles.content: When firmware fails on an embedded microcontroller in the field, there is no browser refresh button. We explore watchdog timer implementations, stack overflow guards, and deterministic state-machine architectures.

articles.title: I Don't Just Learn Things. I Build Things — The Maker Mindset
articles.excerpt: How rapid prototyping and an uncompromising builder philosophy accelerates engineering comprehension 10x faster than passive theory.
articles.content: Theoretical knowledge is essential, but true synthesis occurs when your fingers solder the joints, write the firmware, and watch the circuit come to life. Build to learn, not just learn to build.

travel.description: Travel fuels engineering creativity. From high-altitude mountain trails to robotics fabrication hubs across the globe, here is where ideas collide with the real world.
travel.followSubtitle: Get occasional postcards, expedition logs, and field updates directly to your inbox.

stories.title: Alpine Ridge Exploration
stories.shortDescription: High-altitude trek testing low-temperature telemetry sensors and rugged power banks in sub-zero terrain.
stories.note: High-altitude trek testing low-temperature telemetry sensors and rugged power banks in sub-zero terrain.
stories.fullDescription: Scaling the high-altitude passes of the Himalayas provided an uncompromising test bench for custom embedded electronics. Operating at altitudes above 4,200 meters in sub-zero temperatures, we monitored lithium-iron-phosphate battery chemistry decay, evaluated LoRa long-range telemetry propagation through steep valleys, and tested custom 3D-printed enclosure seals against freezing moisture condensation.
stories.caption: Field testing hardware under extreme temperatures.
stories.altText: Himalayan mountain pass with snow capped peaks

stories.title: Coastal Architecture & Marine Labs
stories.shortDescription: Studying coastal microclimates, tidal power installations, and lightweight saltwater-resistant materials.
stories.note: Studying coastal microclimates, tidal power installations, and lightweight saltwater-resistant materials.
stories.fullDescription: Along the Pacific rim, wave action and constant marine fog create one of nature's harshest corrosion testing environments. We evaluated non-invasive tidal current meters and tested conformal hydrophobic coatings against airborne saline corrosion on sensitive RF circuits.
stories.caption: Marine research outpost testing anti-corrosion materials.
stories.altText: Sunny ocean coast with rocky cliff formations

stories.title: Urban Tech Hubs & Fabrication Centers
stories.shortDescription: Exploring precision CNC workshops, microelectronics suppliers, and industrial robotics prototyping labs.
stories.note: Exploring precision CNC workshops, microelectronics suppliers, and industrial robotics prototyping labs.
stories.fullDescription: Navigating the dense alleys of Akihabara and high-precision machining hubs in Kyoto. Sourced precision planetary gearboxes, inspected 5-axis wire EDM fabrication, and exchanged prototyping methodologies with local hardware makers building autonomous micro-drones.
stories.caption: Sourcing specialized high-precision components in Akihabara.
stories.altText: Tokyo urban cityscape with neon lights at night

stories.title: Night Sky & Observational Astro-Camp
stories.shortDescription: Stargazing and long-exposure deep space imaging with custom tracking mounts and astrophotography gear.
stories.note: Stargazing and long-exposure deep space imaging with custom tracking mounts and astrophotography gear.
stories.fullDescription: Under pristine Bortle Class 1 dark skies in Hanle, Ladakh, light pollution is zero. Armed with equatorial motor tracking mounts driven by custom stepper driver algorithms, we captured long-exposure exposures of the Milky Way core and tested thermal noise reduction on CCD sensors in minus 15-degree conditions.
stories.caption: Long-exposure astro-imaging with custom microcontroller tracking rig.
stories.altText: Milky way galaxy arching over mountain silhouette
